subject: Thank you — donation option & tax receipt for Finex case study
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.inference>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@finex.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Thank you — donation option & tax receipt for Finex case study

Hi Liam —

Really appreciate you and the Finex team agreeing to do a case study with us. As a thank-you we typically offer one of the following: a $500 account credit, a Redwood swag bundle (hoodie + stickers + mug), or we can make a $500 donation to a charity of your choice and provide the official receipt.

You mentioned last week that Finex prefers donations over swag. Two quick clarifications so we can finalize:
- Charity name and preferred contact (for the receipt)
- Whether you need us to make the donation on behalf of Finex Analytics (we can add the exact language requested for tax purposes)

If donation is preferred we can also apply a $250 implementation credit to your account for the integration work you mentioned. If that works, I can loop in Marissa and Priya to get the receipt and the credit processed.

Timeline: once you confirm the charity + wording, we aim to process the donation and email the receipt within 48 business hours. If you prefer the credit instead, we can apply it the same day.

Thanks again for partnering on this — feel free to reply with the details or call if easier.

Best,
Sean
Sean Gallagher
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
(attachment: draft_case_study_outline.pdf - PDF)

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@finex.io>

Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 16:11:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Thank you — donation option & tax receipt for Finex case study

Hi Sean —

Thanks — appreciated. We would prefer Redwood make a donation to GreenLeaf Foundation on our behalf. Please use the following for the receipt:

Organization: Finex Analytics
Address: 42 Liffey Way, Dublin, D02 FXN, Ireland
Tax ID / VAT: IE 1234567V
Statement line: "Donation of $500 made by Redwood Inference on behalf of Finex Analytics in connection with a customer case study (Q3 2026)."

Yes please apply the $250 implementation credit — that will help offset a portion of our integration hours.

One more ask: can you include GreenLeaf's donation reference id (for our records) on the receipt if possible? If you need GreenLeaf's contact, loop in donations@greenleaf.org.

Appreciate the flexibility.

—Liam

Required receipt fields (per customer):

- Address: 42 Liffey Way, Dublin, D02 FXN, Ireland
- Tax ID / VAT: IE 1234567V
- Line item text: "Donation of $500 made by Redwood Inference on behalf of Finex Analytics in connection with a customer case study (Q3 2026)."

Additionally please apply the $250 account credit to Finex (Acct ID: FINEX-9982) and generate a short credit notice we can send along.

Marissa — can you confirm when finance will sign the receipt? Monica — once you have the signed PDF, can you upload to the Drive folder and drop the link here so I can send to Liam?

Thanks,
Sean
